title: --blank flag
detail: `bun create kumiko-app <name> --blank` scaffolds the blank starter: no demo tasks, no seeded password; the creator sets one through "forgot password" after the first start with `KUMIKO_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_EMAIL`.

title: Feature manifest lists contact and its new options
detail: `feature-manifest.json` describes the bundled feature `contact` with its config keys and dependencies (`config`, `delivery`, `user-data-rights`, `files`; `channel-telegram` with option `telegram`), so scaffolding and `kumiko check` know it.

title: The scaffold no longer offers renderer-simple
detail: renderer-simple is removed from the bundled features, so the feature picker and the bundled feature manifest no longer list it. Template-based mails need template-resolver, renderer-foundation and renderer-mail-html.
